title: Tape contents within a field
statement: Let $\Gamma$ be a type, let $fs$ be a finite list of finite words over $\Gamma$, and let $j$ index one of its fields. For every integer $p$ with $-1 \le p \le |fs_j|$, the joined fields tape at the position obtained by adding $p$ to the offset of field $j$ equals the buffer tape storing $fs_j$ at position $p$.
hypotheses_covered: A finite list of words $fs$ over $\Gamma$
